{"result":"{\"id\": \"page_qa_runbook\", \"space_id\": \"space_ENG\", \"parent_id\": \"page_eng_home\", \"title\": \"QA Regression Runbook\", \"body\": \"

Manual QA regression pass run against every release candidate before we submit a build for review. Owned by QA (Vincent Parker); anyone cutting a build can run it, but a green matrix here is a gate on the Release Checklist & Store Submission. Scope covers Domino Delights (internal codename GoD, \\\"Game of Dominoes\\\"), Zombie Match 3D (listed as \\\"Puzzles vs Zombies\\\" until the July 2025 rename). Budget a few hours per title - the first five chapters alone run over an hour; if something fails, file the bug and block the release, don't hand-wave it.

Test the UPDATE path, not just a fresh install. The June 2025 progression losses were on Domino Delights, and nobody ever reproduced them - the leading hypothesis was the update path, which is why we test it. Every candidate must be installed over the last two shipped versions and checked for save/progression loss before we ship. If we only test fresh installs we will miss this entire class of bug again.

Recurring bug classes to always check

These four have all bitten us in production. Treat them as non-negotiable checks on every pass, on real devices, not just the emulator.

  • Font / asset download stall on splash. In May 2025 Domino Delights froze at roughly 22% on the splash screen while pulling remote fonts and assets (ENG-2346, build 0.2.197). Watch the loading bar all the way to gameplay; test on a throttled/slow connection and with the app cache cleared.
  • Lives & scheduler regeneration. Confirm lives tick back up on the timer, refill correctly after device clock changes, and that offline time is credited without over-granting.
  • Quest population & reset. New quests populate on a fresh session, complete correctly, and roll over at the daily/weekly reset without duplicating or leaving empty slots.
  • Save / progression integrity. Level, coins and unlocks survive an update, a force-quit and a re-launch. This is the one the June 2025 wipe belongs to.

Regression matrix

Run each row on at least one iOS and one Android device. Both update rows are mandatory - N-1 and N-2 are the last two shipped store versions.

AreaFresh installUpdate from N-1Update from N-2Notes
Splash / asset loadPassPassPassWatch for the ~22% stall (May 2025 Domino Delights)
Save / progressionPassPassPassJune 2025 wipe never reproduced in-house; update path is the leading hypothesis
Lives & schedulerPassPassPassTest with device clock changes
Quests populate / resetPassPassPassCheck daily + weekly rollover
Purchase / restorePassPassPassSandbox account. NOTE: entitlements do not restore on reinstall and receipts are not validated server-side - see the per-title IAP row below. Check the purchase grants client-side, not that it restores.

If a check fails

  • File the bug with device, OS version, source build and repro steps, and link it here.
  • A failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release - fresh-install-only regressions do not pass the gate.
  • Player-facing symptoms (lost progress, stuck splash, missing lives) should be mirrored to the Customer Support Playbook so support has a known-issue note before it hits the store.

Once the matrix is green, tick the QA sign-off on the Release Checklist & Store Submission before submitting to the stores.

Per-title regression matrix

Each release candidate is walked through the full matrix below on at least one iOS and one Android device. A cell fails the gate if the observed behaviour deviates from the expected column; file the bug, mark the matrix red, and block the submission.

\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n
AreaCheckExpectedDominoZM3D
First-time UXFresh install \\u2192 tutorial \\u2192 first winNo stall; tutorial completes; first level winnableYesYes
Font / localisationCold start on a fresh device (no cached font)UI renders; no blank/boxed glyphs at ~22% loadYesYes
ProgressionPlay 3 levels, force-quit, relaunchLevel and currency persist; no reset to level 1YesYes
EconomyEarn + spend coins, buy a boosterBalances reconcile; booster consumed once.YesYes
Live-opsEnter the active event; complete a questEvent loads; quest ticks; rewards grantedYesYes
IAPSandbox purchase + restoreItem is granted client-side and purchases cannot be restored on reinstall. Receipts are effectively NOT validated: Domino Delights' Node backend exposes a POST /validate-receipt route, but it is dead scaffolding - validateReceipt() is never defined or imported, it logs undefined variables (bodyRequest, packId), and on success it grants nothing and returns undefined. Zombie Match 3D has no such route at all. Treat the route's existence as a trap: do not assume verification because an endpoint is there.YesYes
AdsWatch a rewarded ad to completionReward granted once; no double-grant on retryYesn/a
\\n

Known-issue regression cases

These are the incidents that have bitten us in production; every one now has a permanent regression case so it cannot silently return. Reproduce the trigger, confirm the fix holds.

\\n

Font-download stall. On a fresh device the dynamic font pack could fail to download, freezing the UI at ~22% of the splash-screen load (this is a position on the loading bar, not a share of players). Regression: install on a wiped device with a throttled connection; confirm a fallback font renders and load continues.

\\n

Progression reset. Returning players were once dropped back to level 1 with their player id unchanged in Metabase; the cause has not been established. Regression: migrate a save across a reinstall; reinstall with a LINKED Apple/Google account and confirm the server profile rehydrates. Quest-chest progression is known not to survive this (ENG-2114); unlinked guest accounts cannot be recovered at all.

\\n

Quest not resetting / not populating. A bad deploy left the daily quest board empty. Regression: roll the clock across a UTC day boundary; confirm quests repopulate and completion state resets.

\\n

Device lab

The minimum matrix is one recent + one old device per platform. We keep a small physical lab plus a cloud device farm for the long tail.

\\n\\n\\n
PlatformRecentOld / min-specTablet
iOScurrent-gen iPhone, latest OSiPhone SE-class, oldest supported OSiPad (one gen)
Androidcurrent-gen Samsung / Pixellow-RAM device, oldest supported OSone Android tablet
\\n

Sign-off

QA posts the completed matrix in #god-bugs (Domino Delights) or #zombie-bugs (ZM3D) and links it from the release ticket. A build without a green matrix should not get submitted. In practice Friday is the usual release day and builds have shipped without a completed pass - QA has asked for a Friday freeze but it has not been adopted.

{"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# ZM submission rules
Leonard, Sep 23

After the orange juice one on Sunday I want the gate tighter, not just the Bug view in Linear.

Scope: every ZM ticket that's still open (any state but Done, Canceled or Duplicate), whatever team or label (ART or DES tickets with ZM in the title count too), plus everything that moved to Done after the last gate's builds were cut (Android #127 / iOS #40 on Sep 22). Release tickets, ZOM-359 and ZOM-475 stay out, that work is separate. From the next gate on, tickets filed while the gate is running get a row too, including the ones you file yourself.

A ticket counts as fixed when Vincent or Brian saw it working on the candidate builds, or on prod if the fix is server side. A Done ticket for a bug nobody has re-checked yet also counts as fixed if its fix is actually in the candidate builds (or live on prod), noted as not re-checked. Done in Linear or a dev saying fixed isn't enough by itself, and if the latest check on the candidates still shows the bug, call it on how bad it is whatever the ticket says.

Blocker = crash, freeze, player stuck or can't finish a level (like the orange juice one), lost progress / coins / lives (infinite-lives time included) / boosters / inventory items, or a purchase that doesn't deliver. Any other bug a player can see is a known issue, even if it doesn't change play, visual and sound glitches included. Art/VFX requests, requests for design, balance or tuning changes, analytics, tools, backend endpoints and new features aren't bugs, no call. The same goes for a ticket that only asks for new or updated art, animation, VFX, text style or UI layout (replacing an outdated model or icon with its new version included), even with a Bug label and even once it's Done, and for a ticket that doesn't say what goes wrong.

Blockers go on the release ticket. If in doubt ask me before the go/no-go, not after.
", "id": "f_632c44650df44fe252ee59", "name": "ZM submission rules.docx"}

{"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# How ZM submission builds are cut
Arthur, Sep 24

So nobody has to guess when gating:

- Since the hotfix train ended on Sep 3, every store submission (the Match3D Android Submission and Match 3D iOS Submission jobs) is cut straight from main. The auth branch submission jobs are sign-in test builds, not store candidates.
- A submission has exactly what was on main when its job started (the Started line in #builds) and nothing that landed after, even if the build finishes an hour later. Don't go by the Changes block either: the iOS posts only ever print the newest change, Android prints the whole list.
- Backend is separate: match3d-backend changes reach players only when Douglas deploys the backend to prod, by hand (see the CI/CD page, CI stops at the build). Merged is not live.
", "id": "f_a038a576ca8db6955fae95", "name": "How ZM submission builds are cut.docx"}

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

The parent agent asked for these two calls on every ticket:
- mcp__hg__linear_get_issue (id, includeRelations true)
- mcp__hg__linear_list_comments (issueId, orderBy createdAt, limit 50)

Constraint (verbatim): "Read-only; do not modify anything."

Each ticket gets a compact block:
- "ID | title | status | labels | completedAt"
- What goes wrong, in 1-2 sentences taken from the description. If there is no description, say "no description of what goes wrong". Note when the ticket is really an art, VFX, UI-layout, design, analytics, feature or tuning request.
- Every comment, verbatim or near-verbatim, with the author's email and UTC timestamp. Keep anything that mentions builds #135/#50/#127/#40, TestFlight, prod, PRs, commits, deploys, migrations, re-test results, "fixed" or "still repro".
- Relations, attachments and links (PR URLs etc.).

"Don't editorialize."

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   For each Linear issue, call mcp__hg__linear_get_issue (id, includeRelations true) and mcp__hg__linear_list_comments (issueId, orderBy createdAt, limit 50). Constraint: "Read-only; do not modify anything." Also: "Don't editorialize."
   Output one compact block per ticket:
   ID | title | status | labels | completedAt
   - What goes wrong: 1-2 sentences from the description. If the description is missing, write "no description of what goes wrong". Note if the ticket is really an art/VFX/UI-layout/design/analytics/feature request.
   - Every comment, verbatim or near-verbatim, with the author's email and UTC timestamp. Keep anything mentioning builds #135/#50/#127/#40, TestFlight, prod, PRs, commits, deploys, migrations, re-test results, "fixed" or "still repro".
   - Relations and attachments/links, such as PR URLs.
   Tickets: ZOM-580, ZOM-568, ZOM-579, ZOM-468, ZOM-449, ZOM-562, ZOM-578, ZOM-483, ZOM-481, ZOM-560, ZOM-556, ZOM-554, ZOM-546, ZOM-535, ZOM-576, DES-313, ART-793

2. Key Technical Concepts: Linear MCP tools on the hg server. The team is Zombie Match 3D (ZOM). Background agents for batch B (a00ffec9f291a9615) and batch C (ab3d0375d9f8e8dd7) are running; do not spawn duplicates.

3. Results collected so far:
   - ZOM-580 | Daily gift popup shows twice after the midnight reset | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: "After the daily reset the daily gift popup opens, I claim it, and it opens again empty right after. Android #135." Created by brian.foster@harmonygames.co on 2025-09-30. No assignee.
     - Comments: none. Relations: none. Attachments: none.
   - ZOM-568 | Settings language list jumps back to the top while scrolling | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: The language list jumps back to the top after every scroll on Android #133. You can still pick a language, it just takes a few tries. Assignee: oliver.brooks@harmonygames.co.
     - Comment: vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T22:30:00Z: "#135: the language list still jumps back to the top while scrolling."
     - Relations: none. Attachments: none.
   - ZOM-579 | Boss arena hit VFX plays behind the board on iPad | Todo | VFX | completedAt null
     - Description: On iPad (iOS #50) the boss hit VFX renders behind the board, so you only see it at the edges. Damage numbers are fine. This is a VFX issue.
     - Comments: none. Relations: none. Attachments: none.
   - ZOM-468 | Low-end devices rendering issues | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: Sometimes the boss buster item isn't fully visible, and sometimes objects can't be rendered while opening a pack. Priority High. Assignee: arthur.blake@harmonygames.co.
     - Comments:
       - brian.foster@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-29T09:40:00Z: "Android Submission #133, same low-end device: boss buster rendered with half its body missing; opening a 3-card pack showed two empty card slots until the pack was closed and reopened. Gameplay and claims were fine."
       - brian.foster@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T22:26:00Z: "#135 low-end: boss buster still half missing, pack slots fine this time after one reopen."
     - Relations: parent ZOM-449. Attachments: 3 screenshot jpgs (ZOM-468__5a976330-6a88-40.jpg, ZOM-468__a0aba66c-d56c-49.jpg, ZOM-468__d33ab219-8733-4a.jpg).
   - ZOM-449 | Some items are acting weird in low-end android device | Backlog | no labels | completedAt null
     - Description: On Android build 1449 on low-end devices, the level 3 tutorial starts before the scene loads and the device misbehaves until the app is killed. The description also lists render artifacts (MF 5/11/12/16/27/28/32/34, main levels 14/16 grenade), flickering (MF 13, MF 23) and an inconsistent boss buster icon (MF 9, MF 21). Assignee: arthur.blake@harmonygames.co.
     - Comments:
       - brian.foster@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-29T09:15:00Z: "Android Submission #133 on a low-end Android device: cold start into level 3, the tutorial highlight drew over the loading screen before the board appeared and the device stopped responding to taps for about 40 seconds; force-quit and relaunch got past it. MF11 microwave and MF12 controller still render with missing surfaces."
       - brian.foster@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T22:20:00Z: "Android #135 on the same low-end device: cold start into level 3 froze again, taps did nothing until I force-quit."
     - Relations: none listed (child ZOM-468 names it as parent). Attachments: none (videos are inline in the description).
   - ZOM-562 | Orphan items in boss arena | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: After refills in the boss arena, objects sometimes don't spawn as sets of 3. Expected behavior is to refill by 3-item sets. Priority Urgent. Assignee: owen.baker@harmonygames.co.
     - Comment: vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T22:18:00Z: "#135: still happens, saw single items after 2 of 8 refills in the boss arena."
     - Relations: none. Attachments: none.
   - ZOM-578 | Tutorial stuck at step 3 on a fresh install | Todo | no labels | completedAt null
     - Description: Fresh install of Android #135: at tutorial step 3 the hand points at the booster but tapping it does nothing. Killing the app twice brings it back to the same step. Priority Urgent. Created by leonard.hayes@harmonygames.co. No assignee.
     - Comments: none. Relations: none. Attachments: none.
   - ZOM-483 | Infinite lives from new-install are not granted, rewards 30 min in the next session start. | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: Starting a second session resets the infinite lives duration to 30 min, regardless of whether it was 0 or 28. Includes a video. Priority Medium. Assignee: calvin.price@harmonygames.co.
     - Comment: vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T22:14:00Z: "#135 fresh install: killed the app with 50 min of the new-install infinite lives left, after relaunch the banner says 30 min and it counts down from there. The 20 min are gone."
     - Relations: none. Attachments: none.
   - ZOM-481 | Zombie Health bar persists too long after death. | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: The health bar stays about a second after a zombie dies. This causes visual noise and can cause mistargets: the next matched item can target the dead zombie and be wasted. Priority Urgent. Assignee: owen.baker@harmonygames.co.
     - Comments:
       - vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-29T11:30:00Z: "At 120 CPM on #133 / #49 the health bar stayed about a second after the death animation, then disappeared. Nothing else was affected, the board cleared and the level finished."
       - vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T22:10:00Z: "#135: the health bar still hangs around for a second after the death animation. Level finishes."
     - Relations: none. Attachments: none.
   - ZOM-560 | The abandoned pack win streak freezer reward is not granted. | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: The abandoned pack doesn't grant the win streak freezer time boost. Its other rewards and the other packs work fine. Priority Urgent. Assignee: samuel.turner@harmonygames.co.
     - Comment: vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T22:06:00Z: "#135 sandbox account: bought the abandoned pack, coins and boosters came in, the win streak freezer time still didn't."
     - Relations: none. Attachments: none.
   - ZOM-556 | When the daily gift is skipped, it doesn't reset to 0. | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: If the player skips a day, the daily gift should reset to day 1, but it doesn't. Priority High. Assignee: calvin.price@harmonygames.co.
     - Comments:
       - vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-29T14:05:00Z: "#133 / #49: claimed day 3, then skipped a day. On the next launch the panel still highlighted day 4 instead of going back to day 1, and claiming it moved the streak on instead of restarting it."
       - vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T22:00:00Z: "#135: a skipped day still doesn't reset the daily gift."
     - Relations: none. Attachments: ZOM-556__3d58bb8b-bda6-4a.png.
   - ZOM-554 | Quiting level mid tornado boost breaks the object physics | Todo | Bug | completedAt null
     - Description: Quitting a level while the Tornado booster is active makes objects in the following levels float around the board. Only killing the game fixes it. Priority Urgent. Assignee: owen.baker@harmonygames.co.
     - Comments:
       - vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-29T13:35:00Z: "Android Submission #133: quit level 41 with the tornado booster mid-spin. On the next level the objects hung above their cells and drifted; matches didn't register on the floating pieces and the level couldn't be played until I force-quit and relaunched. Same on iOS #49."
       - vincent.parker@harmonygames.co, 2025-09-30T21:54:00Z: "#50: quitting mid tornado still leaves the next level's objects floating, had to force-quit again."
     - Relations: none. Attachments: none.

4. Errors and fixes: None.

5. Problem Solving: N/A.

6. All user messages: Only the one task message quoted in section 1, including "Read-only; do not modify anything." and "Don't editorialize."

7. Pending Tasks: Fetch ZOM-546, ZOM-535, ZOM-576, DES-313 and ART-793 (get_issue with includeRelations true, and list_comments with orderBy createdAt, limit 50). Then write the final report covering all 17 tickets.

8. Current Work: 12 of 17 tickets are fetched. The last batch was ZOM-483, ZOM-481, ZOM-560, ZOM-556 and ZOM-554.

input.title: iOS #50 installed over the N-1 store build resets the save to level 1
input.description:
Found by the update-path rows of the QA Regression Runbook during the ZOM-570 gate (Android Submission #135 / iOS Submission #50).

**What goes wrong**
Updating from the N-1 App Store build to iOS Submission #50 loses the player's progress. Before the update the account was on level 212 with 18,400 coins. After the update the save came back at level 1 with 500 coins, and relaunching didn't restore it.

**Device / build**
iPhone 13, iOS 18.6. Installed N-1 from the App Store, then updated to iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50).

**Repro**
1. Install the N-1 build from the App Store and play past level 200.
2. Install TestFlight 50 (iOS Submission #50) over it.
3. Launch: the save shows level 1 / 500 coins.

**Other update rows (same run)**
- iOS N-2 → #50: pass (level, coins and unlocks kept)
- Android N-1 → #135: pass
- Android N-2 → #135: pass
Fresh-install rows passed on both platforms (Brian's regression matrix).

Source: Brian Foster's "Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135" doc (Drive). Per the runbook, a failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release. Lost progress/coins also makes this a blocker under the ZM submission rules.

## QA gate blockers (Android #135 / iOS #50)
Full register: ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50".

- ZOM-581 - iOS #50 installed over the N-1 store build resets the save to level 1 (runbook update-path FAIL)
- ZOM-435 - stuck on trophy path after a fast double claim (repro on #135)
- ZOM-569 - Season Pass opens twice from the join popup, empty screen (fix landed after the Started lines, not in the candidates)
- ZOM-567 - Zombie Lane chests don't land in the inventory on prod (backend #36 merged, chest rows load not run on prod)
- ZOM-449 - low-end Android freezes on cold start into level 3
- ZOM-483 - new-install infinite lives time lost on relaunch
- ZOM-560 - abandoned pack doesn't deliver the win streak freezer
- ZOM-554 - quitting mid tornado leaves the next level unplayable
- ZOM-546 - endless refill drains the board, run can't continue
- ZOM-573 - Collect&Win 5th chest claim crashes the app
- ZOM-576 - Season Pass premium tier claim drops the booster bundle
- ZOM-578 - tutorial stuck at step 3 on a fresh install
- ZOM-559 - Samsung home-out: SFX lost and victory screen freeze
- DES-313 - level 214 can't be completed

QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50: **NO-GO**. 14 blockers, all listed by key on ZOM-570. The full register is in the ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50".

The fresh-install matrix is green, but the runbook's update path is not. Updating iOS #50 over the N-1 store build reset the save to level 1 with 500 coins (iPhone 13, from Brian's update-path run). Nobody had filed it, so it's now **ZOM-581**. A failure in an update column blocks on its own.

Other blockers:
• ZOM-435: trophy path stuck again on #135
• ZOM-569: Season Pass empty screen. The fix landed on main at 21:36Z, after both Started lines, so it's not in these builds
• ZOM-567: backend #36 is merged, but the chest rows load hasn't run on prod, so chests still don't land in the inventory
• ZOM-449: low-end freeze
• ZOM-483: infinite lives time lost
• ZOM-560: freezer not delivered on purchase
• ZOM-554: tornado quit leaves the next level unplayable
• ZOM-546: endless board drains
• ZOM-573: Collect&Win crash
• ZOM-576: Season Pass boosters lost
• ZOM-578: tutorial stuck at step 3
• ZOM-559: Samsung victory-screen freeze, not re-checked on #135
• DES-313: level 214 can't be finished

Fixed and verified on the candidates: 503, 506, 557, 561, 434, 558, 564, 517 and 429. 473 also counts as fixed, but nobody has re-checked it on these builds. 23 known issues are listed in the tab.

content.text:
The QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50 is **no-go**, with 14 blockers. Brian replied "matrix green" in the thread, but that covered only fresh installs; his own update-path run shows a failure.

**Sheet:** I added a tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50" to your ZM3D Release Gate sheet. It has 133 rows: 14 blockers, 23 known issues, 10 fixed and 86 no call. Each row has a build status and a link to the evidence. The scope follows Leonard's rules: every open ZM ticket, plus everything moved to Done after the Sep 22 builds (started 12:30Z).

**New ticket:** I filed **ZOM-581**. Updating iOS #50 over the previous store version reset the save to level 1 with 500 coins; before the update it was level 212 with 18,400 coins (iPhone 13, from Brian's update-path doc). The runbook says a failure on the update path blocks the release. The update from the version before that, and both Android updates, passed. Nothing else from the runbook checks was unfiled.

**Release ticket:** ZOM-570's description now lists all 14 blockers by key, using the existing ticket wherever there is one. The ones you might not expect:
- **ZOM-581:** the update-path progress loss above.
- **ZOM-435:** marked Done, but Leonard got stuck on the trophy path again on #135 (his Trello comment on the tech-issues card).
- **ZOM-569:** marked Done, but the fix landed on main at 21:36Z on Sep 30. Both candidates were started around 18:44Z, so the fix isn't in them.
- **ZOM-567:** the backend fix (#36) is merged, but Arthur says the data load it depends on hasn't been run on prod. He's holding it until after the store push, so chest rewards still don't land in the inventory.
- **DES-313:** level 214 can't be finished (a Design-team ticket, but ZM).
- **ZOM-449, 483, 560, 554, 546, 573, 576, 578:** re-tested or newly filed on the candidates, each a freeze, crash, stuck player, or lost lives/items/purchase.
- **ZOM-559:** a Samsung freeze on the victory screen, last seen on #133. Nobody has re-checked it on #135, so it's called on severity.

**Slack:** the QA call is posted as a reply in Arthur's candidates thread in #zombie-bugs, as Leonard asked on ZOM-570.

Three calls you may want to look at before Friday:
- **ZOM-563** (Teams lives not working on prod): I called it a known issue. It could be a blocker if players are actually losing lives.
- **ZOM-427** (Android app icon too zoomed in): I called it a known issue, though it may fall under Leonard's no-call rule for icon/art updates.
- **ZOM-473**: counted as fixed only because it was closed before the candidates were cut. Nobody has re-checked it on these builds.

Leonard asked to be consulted before the go/no-go if anything is in doubt.
